dct_title_s: Total freight movements : the total and the two leading commodities in each Minneapolis district during 1928, calculated by carload
dct_alternative_sm: Total freight movements : the total and the two leading commodities in each Minneapolis district during 1928, calculated by carload
dct_description_sm: Each district on the map shows a small bar graph of freight movement in that district. Bar graphs include a solid black bar indicating total freight; pattern-coded bars indicating the two highest-freight individual commodities; and a solid white scale bar showing the height indicating 8,000 carloads.; Includes table: Actual number of cars and tons of freight loaded and unloaded, the leading commodities, and the percentage comparison [by district].; Includes bar graph: Freight movements [of] the total & the six leading commodities in Minneapolis during 1928, calculated by carload.; Selected areas of the map are colored red or blue.; Penciled on Library's copy: "1552/I-5."; Inscribed on verso: "744."
